title: 銭湯
summary: Neighborhood bathhouses and their painted Mt. Fuji walls.
paragraphs: 銭湯は、町のみんなが使うお風呂です。昔は家にお風呂がない家が多く、銭湯は生活に欠かせない場所でした。
入る前に、体をよく洗います。湯船にタオルを入れてはいけません。かべには、大きな富士山の絵がかいてあることが多いです。
今は数が減りましたが、広いお風呂でゆっくり温まる気持ちよさは、家のお風呂では味わえません。

grammar.explanation: Bath rule: タオルを入れてはいけません = "you must not put towels in the water".
grammar.example: 湯船にタオルを入れてはいけません。
grammar.exampleEn: You must not put your towel in the tub.

paragraphsEn: A sento is a public bath shared by the whole neighborhood. In the old days many homes had no bath of their own, and the sento was an essential part of life.
Before getting in, you wash yourself thoroughly. You must not put your towel in the bathwater. On the wall, more often than not, is a great painting of Mt. Fuji.
Their numbers have dwindled, but the pleasure of a long soak in a big, deep bath is something a bath at home cannot give you.
